title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: In a small Alabama town, young Scout Finch watches her father defend a Black man falsely accused of a crime, and learns hard lessons about justice and courage.

author: George Orwell
description: Winston Smith works for a government that watches everything and rewrites the past, until he dares to think for himself.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy clash, misjudge each other, and slowly see past their first impressions.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Nick Carraway is drawn into the glittering world of his mysterious neighbor Jay Gatsby and his longing for the past.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins is swept from his quiet home into a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphan discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and begins his first year at Hogwarts.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: Teenager Holden Caulfield wanders New York City for a few days after being expelled from school.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Frodo inherits a dangerous ring and sets out with a small fellowship to keep it from the Dark Lord.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: In a future built on comfort and control, one man begins to question the price of a perfectly ordered society.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A shepherd boy travels from Spain to the Egyptian desert in search of treasure and his personal legend.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: On the desert planet Arrakis, young Paul Atreides is caught in a war over the most valuable substance in the universe.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: A symbologist and a cryptologist follow a trail of clues hidden in famous works of art.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: On their fifth anniversary Amy Dunne disappears, and her husband quickly becomes the main suspect.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A journalist and a brilliant hacker investigate a woman's disappearance forty years earlier.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
description: Ten strangers are invited to an island, and one by one they begin to die.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her sister's place in a televised fight to the death.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: Two teenagers who meet at a cancer support group fall in love and chase answers about a favorite novel.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A short history of humankind, from early hunter-gatherers to the modern world.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny daily changes.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: Raised without school in rural Idaho, the author teaches herself enough to reach university and beyond.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: Stranded alone on Mars, astronaut Mark Watney uses science and humor to survive.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A schoolteacher wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory and a mission to save Earth.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe tells the story of how he grew from a gifted child into the most notorious wizard of his age.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: A street thief with rare powers joins a crew planning to overthrow an immortal emperor.

title: The Night Circus
author: Erin Morgenstern
description: Two young magicians are bound to a contest that plays out inside a circus open only at night.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
author: Delia Owens
description: Abandoned as a child in the North Carolina marshes, Kya grows up alone until a death puts her under suspicion.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A famous painter shoots her husband and then never speaks again; a therapist sets out to uncover why.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
description: The four March sisters grow up during the American Civil War, each chasing her own dreams.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist creates life, then flees from the creature he has made.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Told through letters and diaries, a group of friends hunts the vampire who has come to England.

title: The Shining
author: Stephen King
description: A family takes a winter caretaking job at an isolated hotel with a violent past.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: A gifted child is trained in battle school to lead humanity's fight against an alien threat.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: Seconds before Earth is demolished, Arthur Dent is rescued by an alien friend and begins a ridiculous journey through space.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: A tour of the two systems that drive the way we think, and the mistakes each one makes.

title: The Kite Runner
author: Khaled Hosseini
description: A story of friendship, betrayal, and redemption between two boys growing up in Kabul.

title: Normal People
author: Sally Rooney
description: Connell and Marianne circle each other from school in Ireland through university in Dublin.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
description: An aging Hollywood star finally tells a young journalist the truth about her glamorous life.

title: The Book Thief
author: Markus Zusak
description: In Nazi Germany, a young girl steals books and shares them with her neighbors and the man hiding in her basement.

title: Circe
author: Madeline Miller
description: The witch Circe, banished to an island, tells her own story among gods and mortals of Greek myth.

title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: Between life and death lies a library where every book is a different life Nora could have lived.

title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R.R. Martin
description: Noble families scheme and fight for the Iron Throne while an ancient threat stirs in the north.

title: Becoming
author: Michelle Obama
description: The former First Lady describes her childhood in Chicago, her career, and her years in the White House.

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
description: In a world where books are banned and burned, fireman Guy Montag begins to question his job.

title: Shatter Me
author: Tahereh Mafi
description: Juliette's touch can kill, and a ruthless regime wants to use her as a weapon. When someone from her past reappears, she has to decide who she can trust.

title: The Cruel Prince
author: Holly Black
description: Jude is a mortal girl raised in the High Court of Faerie, where she is despised. To win a place there she must play a dangerous game of politics and betrayal.

title: Fourth Wing
author: Rebecca Yarros
description: Violet Sorrengail was meant to be a scribe, but is forced into a war college where cadets train to bond with dragons. Those who fail don't survive.

title: Once Upon a Broken Heart
author: Stephanie Garber
description: Evangeline Fox is desperate to stop the boy she loves from marrying someone else, so she makes a bargain with the dangerous Prince of Hearts.

title: Better Than the Movies
author: Lynn Painter
description: Liz is a hopeless romantic who wants a movie-perfect love story. She teams up with her annoying neighbor Wes to win over her crush.

title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
author: Sarah J. Maas
description: Feyre is a hunter who kills a wolf in the woods and is dragged to a faerie land as payment, where her captor is not what he seems.
